meta.source: fanza-stipop prod DB (read-only SELECT) + Mixpanel project 4030771 (through 2026-11-14)

b1_free_allotment.room_free_note: T_USER_CHAT_FREE: 1 row per user x OWNER (N=others chars, Y=own chars), limit 5 (ROOM_FREE_LIMIT) -> max 10 if user also chats own char
b1_free_allotment.return_reward: 3 free msgs/day on first 3 return days (not signup day); T_RETURN_REWARD since 2026-10-07 18:25:52

b1_dropout_wall.definition: 12w signups (8/17-11/07) with >=1 msg, <20 msgs ever, no activity in last 7d; balances at last message: room free (OWNER=N row), today return reward, bonus ledger BALANCE_AFTER, campaign credit; shortage event = Mixpanel Send Fail Point / Popup point_short / Error point_shortage within -10min..+24h of last msg

b1_mp_first_response.source: Mixpanel Claude/Gemini Response Details (server), first event per userId, 12w signups

b2_payment_wall.definition: signups since 8/17 whose T_USER_CHAT_FREE row reached 5 (time = UPDATE_DATE); excludes users who paid DMM before
first Mixpanel Send Fail Point / point_short popup / point_shortage error (= free+bonus+DMM all insufficient); excludes prior DMM payers

b2_first_dmm_payment.definition: first T_DMM_POINT row (one charge) per user; first-24h = sum of charges in 24h after it

b4_s7_days_signup_to_s7.definition: S7 time = first day the S7 rule (3+ pay days or pt>=P90 in trailing 30d) was met, from all DMM history

b4_s7_active_days_30d.note: active day = message or feature event that day (JST)

b5_video_funnel.definition: video = non-failed T_SCENE video generation row or DMM charge with feature ntr_video/char-video; events within 2 min of the previous one for the same user merged as one video (dedupe gen row vs charge)

b6_s0.definition: signups 8/17-11/14 with 0 messages ever (1:1+group/NTR/story). Mixpanel Page View/Button Click/Chat Room View 8/10-11/14, $insert_id dedupe, distinct_id = user id (includes merged pre-signup guest events)
b6_s0.note: no dedicated character-detail page_name exists; character detail = Artist (creator profile) page; chat room = chat_room / n-group_room / story_room Page View or Chat Room View event
